nodes.body_text: def _correct_group(title: str, group: list[dict], candidates: dict, corrections: list[dict]) -> None: if not ARTICLE.match(title): return expected = _article_number(title) numbered = [(item, match) for item in group if (match := PREFIX.match(item["text"]))] if len(numbered) < 2: return first, second = numbered[0][1], numbered[1][1] # Infer a misread zero only from a 0,2 sequence in the same article. if first.group(1) != "0" or second.group(1) != "2" or first.group(3) != second.group(3): return raw = first.group(3) expected_text = str(expected) if expected is not None else None article_fix = (expected_text and raw != expected_text and raw == expected_text.replace("1", "0") and "1" in expected_text) if not expected_text or (raw != expected_text and not article_fix): return if article_fix: candidates[raw].add(expected_text) for item, match in numbered: if match.group(3) != raw: continue ordinal = "1" if item is numbered[0][0] else match.group(1) replacement = ordinal + "-" + (expected_text if article_fix else raw) _record_correction(item, replacement + item["text"][match.end():], match.group(0), replacement, corrections)

nodes.signature: def _correct_references(clauses: list[dict], candidates: dict, known_articles: set[int], corrections: list[dict]) -> None
nodes.body_text: def _correct_references(clauses: list[dict], candidates: dict, known_articles: set[int], corrections: list[dict]) -> None: for raw, targets in candidates.items(): if len(targets) != 1: continue target = next(iter(targets)) # A leading-zero reference may refer to a different existing article. if int(raw) in known_articles and int(raw) != int(target): continue expression = re.compile(r"(?<!\w)(ماده\s*)" + re.escape(raw) + r"(?!\d)") for item in clauses: after = expression.sub(lambda match: match.group(1) + target, item["text"]) _record_correction(item, after, "ماده " + raw, "ماده " + target, corrections)
